description.zh:
日志投递类型。取值：

- **sls**： 表示阿里云日志服务。
- **kafka**：表示外发投递到kafka日志。
- **syslog**：表示外发投递到syslog日志。
description.en:
The log delivery type. Valid values:

- **sls**: Simple Log Service.

- **kafka**: Kafka.

- **syslog**: Syslog.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The protected object whose log field configuration you want to query.
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

title.zh: 查询防护对象的日志字段配置
